# Verdetto

> Verdetto is a free QR code and barcode scanner for Android with no ads and no fake buttons. It shows the link before it opens, reads damaged codes, and checks scanned content for warning signs on the phone. It never says anything is safe: "No warnings found" means none of its checks matched.

Publisher: Verdetto, 1520 Belle View Blvd, Suite #5992, Alexandria, VA 22307, United States. Contact: support@verdettoqr.com. Store title: "Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner". Status: coming soon to Google Play.

## Pages

- [Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner for Android](https://verdettoqr.com/): A QR code and barcode scanner for Android. No ads, no fake buttons. See the link before it opens. Reads damaged codes.
- [Privacy policy](https://verdettoqr.com/privacy): Privacy policy for Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Scanning happens on your phone.
- [Terms of use](https://verdettoqr.com/terms): Terms of use for Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner. What the safety checks are and are not, and that every decision on scanned content is yours.
- [Support](https://verdettoqr.com/support): Support for Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner. How to reach us and answers to common questions.
- [How to check a QR code link before you open it](https://verdettoqr.com/check-qr-code-link): Six things to look at in a QR code's link before you tap it: the domain, shortened links, lookalike names, the connection, downloads, and where the code was placed.

## Facts

- Platform: Android. Price: free. Ads: none. Accounts: none. Analytics: none.
- Scanning and every safety check run on the phone; online lookups (list updates, shortened-link destinations, domain age, product details from Open Food Facts and Open Library) are on by default and can be turned off.
- Reads QR codes and barcodes including EAN, UPC, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417, and Aztec, including damaged ones.
- Scan history stays on the phone and can be deleted by the person.
- The only permission requested is the camera.
- An optional in-app contribution supports development; nothing is locked behind it.
